blocks.html:
For individuals who are struggling with alcohol and drugs, Dallas Detox is the ideal drug and alcohol detox center near Wichita Falls, TX. Our staff understands the chaos that addiction can have on a person’s life, and will work with you to ensure that you feel prepared to begin your recovery at home. Our luxurious treatment facility and our compassionate staff will make you feel at home so you may focus your energy on your recovery.

Many of the individuals who come to Dallas Detox benefit from using our detoxification program. Going through this phase of your recovery in a detoxification program can have a significant impact on your experience. Withdrawal can include uncomfortable and even painful moments, which can benefit from medications that can ease your distress. Another challenge many experiences is intense cravings which our staff can support you through.

The inpatient rehab program at Dallas Detox can range from 30 to 60 days in length. Every individual that we work with receives a custom treatment approach that can impact the duration of their program. Individuals who would benefit from specialized treatment options, including dual-diagnosis care, maybe in treatment longer to ensure that they are prepared with the necessary tools for their recovery. Our inpatient treatment program utilizes group therapy, individual therapy, and educational sessions to provide you with the tools needed for a healthy recovery.

Once your time at Dallas Detox is complete, you will be eligible to receive Alumni support services that are unique to our treatment center. This can include check-ups like appointments to see how you are adjusting to your recovery and even assistance with re-admission if you ever need treatment in the future. If you have been struggling with drugs or alcohol, you can likely think of several ways that your use has impacted your life. If you are ready to take the next step in your recovery, take a moment to think about what you would like your life to look like in recovery and explore your motivation for getting sober. When you are ready, Dallas Detox is here to provide you with the support, kindness, and encouragement you deserve. Call (817)904-2197 to get started today!
